selection_basis: targeted-set-v1 with stage_base=58d3dc5b, applied to the stage's OWN change set. Measured with the literal TB-05 algorithm (test_roots = tests/unit|contract|integration|scenarios; candidate = every test_*.py, 392 files; rule (a) = any candidate whose bytes contain a changed repository-relative path or its module stem; rule (b) = spec short name / delivery-surface paths; rule (c) = fixtures): the stage's own change set (requirements.md, checklists/requirements.md, plan.md, feature-ref.md and this test-evidence directory) selects 185 of 392 candidates. So the selection is NOT the empty set by construction — spec prose quotes many framework paths that test modules assert on. Honest reason no pytest run backs this row: every one of those 185 selected files is a contract/integration/unit test over FRAMEWORK SOURCES (skills/, shared/, scripts/, templates/, .specify/). This stage changed none of them; the only framework-source bytes that differ in this working tree are the user-preserved uncommitted concurrent implementation, which this stage is forbidden to commit. Running the selection therefore measures that concurrent work, not this stage, which is why it is recorded as an observation (probe, in evidence_ptr) rather than as the E3 result: 1 failed / 89 passed over the five most directly affected suites, the single failure being test_c5_non_wiring_files_keep_their_frozen_hashes vs the uncommitted work tree (drifted: create-skills, improve-skills, merge-skills SKILL.md) — a pre-existing effect already disclosed by the plan-stage row and unchanged by this stage. The full suite was not run, the implement-start (E2) baseline was neither captured nor consumed and the closure slot is untouched; the deterministic gates that do apply ran and their verbatim output is in evidence_ptr.
sufficiency: docs-only, with the measurement above stated: no framework source and no test file was changed by this stage, so none of the 185 selected candidates can be affected by it. Sufficiency of the gates (not tests) is complete — validate-requirements, pre-analyze-check --stage requirements, decomposition-check --mode plan and the flow-class lookup are exactly the instruments that read the artifacts this stage produced.
baseline: na — no test baseline captured or consumed in a docs-only stage; the frozen pre-implementation baseline remains the requirements-stage record and no slot was spent here
